title: Adobe just put more than 70 of its tools inside ChatGPT
excerpt: Adobe has launched one ChatGPT plugin bringing 70+ tools, from Photoshop to Firefly, into the chatbot, while insisting it won't replace its apps.
content_html:
Adobe’s whole business is the apps creative professionals open every day. This week it put more than 70 of those tools inside a rival’s chatbot. The company has launched a single Adobe plugin for ChatGPT that pulls in Photoshop, Premiere, Lightroom, Illustrator, InDesign, Acrobat, Express, and its Firefly generative models.

It replaces the handful of separate connectors Adobe shipped late last year through OpenAI’s Apps SDK. Now there is one extension, added from ChatGPT’s settings and summoned by typing @Adobe. It is available worldwide from today.

What it actually does

You describe a task in plain language, and the plugin works out which Adobe tools it needs. Then it runs them behind the scenes. You can apply one style across a batch of product photos, resize a design for different platforms, or turn a spreadsheet into an Acrobat PDF. Hand it a long video, and it can cut a highlight reel and reformat it for Shorts, Reels, or TikTok.

You can use the plugin as a guest. Signing in to a Creative Cloud account unlocks more, including saving work across sessions and generating images with Firefly. Adobe says it runs best inside OpenAI’s Codex app and its recently launched Work suite, Engadget reported. How much you can generate depends on your ChatGPT plan.

A tool inside someone else’s front door

The strategy is the real story. The chatbot is becoming the place people start their work, and Adobe would rather be summoned inside ChatGPT than lose the user who never opens Photoshop again. It is meeting people on a rival’s surface before that surface swallows the workflow whole.

Adobe is careful to draw a line.

“We want Adobe’s pro-grade tools for creativity and productivity to be available wherever people work,” said Forest Key, its vice-president of Firefly and agentic AI. The plugin “isn’t a replacement” for the flagship apps, he added, which “go deeper when projects call for hands-on precision”. Speaking to CNET, product lead Deepti Pradeep framed it as an on-ramp back into Adobe’s own apps.

For OpenAI the logic is simpler. Every task it can absorb is a reason not to leave ChatGPT, which feeds its ambition to be the app people never close.

The tightrope

There is a catch, and Adobe names it. The plugin will not deliver pixel-perfect results, Digital Trends noted, and the flagship apps remain the place for precision. There is a harder tension too. Adobe is baking generative AI deeper into its products, through Firefly and new Photoshop assistants, even as many professional creators remain hostile to generative tools.

The company is betting it can be both the chatbot’s creative engine and the professional’s trusted studio. The risk is that the first makes the second feel optional.

content_html_zh:
Adobe 的全部业务就是创意专业人士每天打开的应用程序。 本周，该公司将其中 70 多个工具放入竞争对手的聊天机器人中。 该公司为 ChatGPT 推出了一款 Adob​​e 插件，可引入 Photoshop、Premiere、Lightroom、Illustrator、InDesign、Acrobat、Express 及其 Firefly 生成模型。

它取代了 Adob​​e 去年年底通过 OpenAI Apps SDK 发布的少数独立连接器。 现在有一个扩展程序，是从 ChatGPT 的设置中添加的，并通过输入 @Adobe 来调用。 从今天起，它在全球范围内发售。

它实际上做了什么

您用简单的语言描述任务，插件就会计算出它需要哪些 Adob​​e 工具。 然后它在幕后运行它们。 您可以在一批产品照片中应用一种样式，针对不同平台调整设计大小，或者将电子表格转换为 Acrobat PDF。 给它一个长视频，它可以剪切精彩片段并将其重新格式化为 Shorts、Reels 或 TikTok。

您可以以访客身份使用该插件。 登录 Creative Cloud 帐户可以解锁更多功能，包括跨会话保存工作以及使用 Firefly 生成图像。 据 Engadget 报道，Adobe 表示，它在 OpenAI 的 Codex 应用程序及其最近推出的 Work 套件中运行得最好。 您可以生成多少取决于您的 ChatGPT 计划。

别人前门内的工具

该策略是真实的故事。 聊天机器人正在成为人们开始工作的地方，Adobe 宁愿被召唤到 ChatGPT 中，也不愿失去不再打开 Photoshop 的用户。 它是在竞争对手的表面吞没整个工作流程之前与该表面上的人会面。

Adobe 小心翼翼地划定了界限。

“我们希望无论人们在哪里工作，都可以使用 Adob​​e 的专业级工具来提高创造力和生产力，”Firefly 和 Agentic AI 副总裁 Forest Key 说道。 他补充说，该插件“不能替代”旗舰应用程序，“当项目需要实际操作精度时，旗舰应用程序会更深入”。 产品负责人 Deepti Pradeep 在接受 CNET 采访时将其视为重返 Adob​​e 自家应用程序的入口。

对于 OpenAI 来说，逻辑更简单。 它能承担的每一项任务都是一个不离开 ChatGPT 的理由，这满足了它成为人们永远不会关闭的应用程序的雄心。

走钢丝

Adobe 将其命名为“陷阱”。 Digital Trends 指出，该插件不会提供像素完美的结果，旗舰应用程序仍然是精确的地方。 还有更严峻的紧张局势。 Adobe 正在通过 Firefly 和新的 Photoshop 助手将生成式 AI 更深入地融入其产品中，尽管许多专业创作者仍然对生成工具抱有敌意。

该公司押注它既可以成为聊天机器人的创意引擎，又可以成为专业人士值得信赖的工作室。 风险在于，第一个选项会让第二个选项显得可有可无。
